title: Michelle's Sweet Game
style: light swing jazz pop, female lead vocal sweet and dreamy, soft piano, brushed drums, walking upright bass, warm muted trumpet accent, sunny uplifting, 96 bpm, gentle playful feel
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Little bright ball, big sunny day
Michelle smiling, ready to play
Paddle in hand, light in her eyes
Michelle on the court, sweet little prize

[Verse 2]
Soft little drop, sweet little spin
Michelle has a quiet way to win
Gentle as a song, light as a tune
Michelle on the court, sunny afternoon

[Chorus]
Michelle's sweet game, Michelle's sweet day
Bright yellow ball and the way she plays
Like a bee to a flower, soft and bright
Michelle on the court, everything is right

[Verse 3]
Friends laughing, soft little breeze
Michelle moves around with such ease
No big swing, no big shout
Michelle just knows what she's about

[Chorus]
Michelle's sweet game, Michelle's sweet day
Bright yellow ball and the way she plays
Like a bee to a flower, soft and bright
Michelle on the court, everything is right

[Bridge]
Sunny Saturday, gentle little tune
Michelle and the ball under the noon
Not a worry, not a care
Michelle is happy, Michelle is there

[Outro]
Michelle's sweet game…
Bright yellow forever…
Michelle and the ball… always together…
